scenario: A software factory needs a design with a foreman agent between the human and the factory, a separate validator, a different-model critic, MCP wiring, observability views, and convergence rules.
prompt: design a software factory with foreman role, validator role, critic model, MCP connections, observability views, and convergence rules; emit a FactoryDesign artifact as JSON and Markdown.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the foreman agent sits between the human and the factory; code-writing agents never talk directly to the human
the validator is separate from the code-writer and never reviews its own output
the critic runs a different model tier than the factory workers
MCP connections and observability views are declared, not improvised
convergence rules decide act, check, escalate, or handBack; the factory is simplified when it stops converging
grounding: .agents/skills/engineering/software-factory/SKILL.md#Rules - foreman between human and factory, separate validator, different-model critic, declared MCP and observability, convergence rules
.agents/skills/engineering/software-factory/SKILL.md#Workflow - design foreman, configure validator, select critic, wire MCP, define observability, set convergence rules, emit artifact

.agents/skills/engineering/software-factory/SKILL.md#Guardrails - separate validator and critic from code-writer, decide act/check/escalate/handBack, simplify when not converging, no runtime execution

instructionFollowing.criterion: The foreman role is designed with factoryName, modelTier, maxConcurrency, batchSize, and splitPolicy.

levels.4: all foreman fields are populated with concrete values
levels.2: most foreman fields are populated but some are missing

instructionFollowing.criterion: The validator is separate from the code-writer with validatorRole, qualityThreshold, and passCriteria; it never generates code or reviews its own output.

levels.4: validator is fully configured and separate from code-writing
levels.2: validator is partially configured or not clearly separate

instructionFollowing.criterion: The critic model is selected on a different model tier than the factory workers and independently assesses factory behavior.

levels.4: critic model is on a different tier and performs independent assessment
levels.2: critic model is selected but on the same tier or assessment is not independent

instructionFollowing.criterion: MCP connections and observability views are declared with serverId, transport, capabilities and viewId, metric, sink respectively.

levels.4: all MCP connections and observability views are fully declared
levels.2: MCP or observability declarations are partial
levels.0: no MCP connections or observability views are declared

goalCompletion.criterion: Convergence rules are set with ruleId, trigger, and action (act, check, escalate, handBack); the factory is simplified when it stops converging.

levels.4: all convergence rules are populated with valid actions and simplification is addressed
levels.2: convergence rules are partial or simplification is not addressed

goalCompletion.criterion: The code-writing machine is kept away from reviewing itself; validator and critic are separate from code-writers and run different models.

levels.4: clear separation between code-writing, validation, and criticism with different models
levels.2: separation is partial or models overlap
levels.0: no separation; code-writer reviews its own output

goalCompletion.criterion: No runtime execution occurs; the skill produces a design artifact only and does not start agents, call MCP servers, or write production code.

levels.4: only a FactoryDesign artifact is produced; no runtime execution
levels.2: artifact is produced but some runtime execution is attempted

goalCompletion.criterion: The FactoryDesign artifact is saved as JSON and Markdown with completion criteria met and blockers documented.

levels.4: artifact saved in both formats with all completion criteria met
levels.2: artifact produced but not saved in both formats or criteria not met

check.note: the FactoryDesign must contain all required sub-fields
convergence rule actions must cover all four action types
negative control: no runtime execution, agent startup, MCP calls, or production code generation

assertions.note: the factory design must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Is the code-writing machine kept away from reviewing itself, with validator and critic separate and running different models?

levels.pass: validator and critic are separate from code-writers with different models
levels.fail: code-writer reviews its own output or models overlap

check.criterion: Is there no runtime execution; only a FactoryDesign artifact is produced?

levels.pass: only a design artifact is produced with no runtime execution
levels.fail: runtime execution, agent startup, or production code generation occurs

check.criterion: Are convergence rules populated with valid act/check/escalate/handBack actions?

levels.pass: convergence rules have ruleId, trigger, and valid action
levels.fail: convergence rules are missing or have invalid actions
